title: The Garage
what: Six speech engines that VoiceStudio can install and run on the same PC, all saying the same sentence. The race is the time each took to make it (after loading).

inputs.label: Line
inputs.value: Six engines, one sentence, and a race to the far end of the garage. Ready, steady, go!

inputs.label: Engines
inputs.value: VoiceStudio (OmniVoice) (CC BY-NC 4.0), IndexTTS 2.5 (IndexTTS licence), CosyVoice 3 (Apache 2.0), PocketTTS (CC BY 4.0), Supertonic 3 (OpenRAIL-M), KittenTTS (Apache 2.0)

inputs.label: Voices
inputs.value: Otto cloned by three engines; PocketTTS voice alba; Supertonic 3 voice M1; KittenTTS voice expr-voice-2-m

inputs.label: Finish order
inputs.value: VoiceStudio (OmniVoice) 0.36 s · PocketTTS 1.76 s · Supertonic 3 1.81 s · IndexTTS 2.5 2.94 s · CosyVoice 3 3.43 s · KittenTTS 4.12 s

snippet:
import requests
r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": TEXT,
    "language": "English",
    "engine": "cosyvoice",
    "profile_id": "OTTO_ID",
    "seed": 1111,
})
open("take.wav", "wb").write(r.content)
checks: Every engine timed 3 times after loading; the median is shown
